notes.title: Version 7.1
notes.notes:
Camera movement has been adjusted.
The ban system has been adjusted.
Chat system has been adjusted.
Ship not sinking bug has been fixed
Bomb damage increased from 15,000 to 25,000.
Added option to purchase naval coins via iOS for iOS.
A menu has been added where we can see active items.
The mission to sink the player has been adjusted. (The mission will now progress even if the player does not give battle points).
Added 5% critical and 5% damage to the chest for 5 days.
Ghost event added.
Some bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Version 7.0
notes.notes:
Increased the chance of players under level 20 dropping the cannon.
Added WASD hotkey replacement.
Fleet tag and name change added.
Shield upgrade increased.
Gunpowder upgrade increased.

Event added.

notes.title: Version 6.9
notes.notes:
Detachment time from the fleet has been reduced to 1 day.
Chat-Bot has been developed.
Some text bugs have been fixed.
Message reporting system has been improved.
Added new aggressive NPC. (There is a possibility of dropping a ball of 50 kg) (Map 17-18-19-20)
New event added.
The event system has been adjusted. (Boss ship health increased, monster removed)
Some bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Version 6.8
notes.notes:
The problem of not working on Android 14 phones has been resolved.
The amount of elite points in the auction has been increased from one million to three million.
Added chance of a snowball coming out of the chest.
Snow cannonball was added to the tender.
Ramadan event added.
Some bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Version 6.7
notes.notes:
Damage to fleet towers quest has been changed.
Donating diamonds is blocked if your fleet is at the last level.
Added counter to raid map.
Viking event added.
Fixed the delay issue in ship attack speed.
Added chance for Admirals (Bosses) to drop 50 kg cannon, storm cannon, Maki cannon. (5% - 50 pound cannon, 2% Storm cannon, 0.5% Maki cannon)
Some bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Version 6.6
notes.notes:
The player cannot leave the game if someone hits him while leaving the game.
Added cooldown when building a fleet.

The health of Admirals and Salazars has been increased by 2 times.
Raid map elite point rate increased by 2 times.
100M elite points package added. (Can only be purchased once)
10M elite point packages added. (Players with Elite level below 33 can purchase)
Account information system has been edited.
Chat-Bot has been developed.
Some texts have been fixed.
Pirate event added.

NPC points added.

notes.notes:
Only players lower than level 20 will be able to enter the new world.
Elite stone time restriction has been removed.
During the event, gold and diamond packages will be 50% off.
Gold package has been arranged.
Donating diamonds to the player has been removed.
NPC health rate increased.
NPC gold rate increased.
Automatic quick repair added.
Automatic speed stone added.

Increased rocket damage in auction.

notes.title: Version 6.1
notes.notes:
Adjusted the appearance of the rocket.
Rocket Damage increased to 1500.
Auction has been adjusted.
Profile has been adjusted.
Raid map rewards have been increased.

Added new country ship.

notes.title: Version 6.0
notes.notes:
The level limit for sending diamonds and gold to your friend has been increased to 20.
Grand line, raid map, bonus map can only be teleported on safe maps.
Fleet tower health increased.
Grand line and raid map days were organized.
The auction was renewed.
A new item has been added to the auction.
Added new rocket upgrade.
Added the ability to turn the maki cannon back into the storm cannon.
Added Gold and Diamond pack.
All players can attack each other on the grand line map.
Players who are not in a fleet cannot enter the grand line map.
Raid map (PVE) reward increased.
If the player does not have a fleet, they cannot earn battle points.
Added new warship.
Some bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Version 5.9
notes.notes:
Low sea have been adjusted.
Ship optimization bug fixed.
When the tower is built, the logbook shows which player built it.
Chat has been improved.
Added notification when an item is purchased.
Health bar color changed.
Added 5 new cannons slot improvements.
Added feature to increase critical damage.
Special ship limit increased from 10 to 15.
10 Naval Coins added to the auction.
Added item to increase critical rate in the auction (2 days).
Added new data to the profile.

notes.title: Version 5.8
notes.notes:
By pressing the "ENTER" key, the game can be logined.
Added interface shutdown feature with ESC hotkey.
Missions have been arranged.
Fleets are now searched by ID.
Added option to show and adjust fps.
Added forgot mail feature.
Added account deletion feature.
Added see other leagues in the ranking.
Added the information of the last attacking player.
Added blacklist.

Added new battle map (Grand Line).
Written corrections have been made.
Event rewards have been increased.
Some bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Version 5.7
notes.notes:
The last level tower costs 15M gold.
Medium starter pack increased from 10 storm cannons to 15 storm cannons.
Interface and text corrections have been made.
Daily quests and quests have been translated into every language available in the game.
Added Merchant Boss. (When a total of 1500 Meat is sunk between 1-20 maps, Gol D. Roger will appear on the map)
Added mode where you can see all players (except yourself) low-level ships.

notes.title: Version 5.6
notes.notes:
Interface and text corrections have been made.
Added the feature to show the name of the player with the team when he sinks an NPC.
Added to the Raid Map on Friday.
Ranks are now calculated by (battle points, experience points, elite points and level).
A new boss (Blackbeard) has been added to the game. (Map between 13-20) It appears at 08:00-08:05 and 20:00-20:05 o'clock server time.
Added special effect when ship sinks (separate for NPC and Player).
Added flame effect to cannons when the ship fires.
Added new non-animated sea.
A fleet donation task was organized.
Added new battle ranks.
Added battle ranks rewards.
Added Mid-Starter pack.
Added two new towers.
Tower build time will be increased from 20 minutes to 25 minutes.
Added Cherry Blossom Event.
Some bugs have been fixed.

Increased the number of Ettans on the map.
Added option to sell Maki and Storm cannons.
Fixed login bug to bonus map.
Removed ammo packs.
The chest counter has been adjusted. (If a storm ball spawns while the chest counter is at 1050, the counter remains at 50.)
The system gives 500 keys to those who reach level 20 and are not banned for chat.
Added high-quality sea option on mobile.
Added the option to send diamonds to a friend.
Added raid map PVE.
Added transition to the interface with tab.
Added level up the Maki cannons.
Range view changed.
Added candy event.
Tower range increased by 10%.
Only players above level 15 can throw gold and diamonds to friends.
Salazar spawns after every auction.
Increased the number of sparkles on the map.
Group system added.
Gunpowder and Shield level appear in the UI.

The number of collective purchases of products sold in the market has increased.
Added gunpowder and shield upgrades.
